definitions.explanation: Describes someone who spends money freely and generously, especially when treating others or giving gifts. Always a positive description.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気前|きまえ}がいい。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気前|きまえ}がいい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦おごって→おごる：08157_ogoru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The boss is generous, so he often treats us to meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気前|きまえ}がよくて、⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧お⟦{小遣|こづか}い→小遣い：12363_kozukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Grandma is very generous and always gives her grandchildren lots of spending money.

notes:
A common expression describing generosity with money. ⟦{気前|きまえ}→気前：07794_kimae⟧ by itself means one's disposition regarding spending, and it almost always appears with ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (good) or よい.

FORMS:
⟦{気前|きまえ}→気前：07794_kimae⟧ (generosity, disposition toward spending) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (good)
- {気前|きまえ}がいい / ⟦{気前|きまえ}→気前：07794_kimae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よい: generous (standard)
- ⟦{気前|きまえ}→気前：07794_kimae⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: generously (adverb form)
- ⟦{気前|きまえ}→気前：07794_kimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a generous person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦けち→けち：02792_kechi⟧な: stingy, miserly — the informal antonym
- ⟦{気前|きまえ}→気前：07794_kimae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: ungenerous — rarely used; ⟦けち→けち：02792_kechi⟧ is preferred
- ⟦{太|ふと}っ{腹|ぱら}→太っ腹：15692_futoppara⟧: big-hearted, magnanimous — stronger, often about major generosity
- ⟦{寛大|かんだい}→寛大：15278_kandai⟧: generous, tolerant — more about attitude than money
- ⟦{奮発|ふんぱつ}→奮発：15756_funpatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to splurge — describes a specific act of spending generously
